items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 62:1
items.html: There are two discernments of lights and vessels in the world of correction: first, what remained of the lights and vessels of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, and likewise what was sorted from the dead kings; and these are called by the name BON, or the old light, and from them are made all the females of the Partzufim of Atzilut. And the second discernment is what came out anew in the couplings, for the sake of the world of Atzilut itself, in the secret of the light that came out from the illumination of the forehead of AK, and likewise all the couplings in the world of Atzilut are discerned as the discernment of a new light relative to the lights of BON. And this is the secret of the "HaVaYaH of MA of the filling of Alephs", which came out from the forehead of AK, and from these lights and vessels were built all the male Partzufim of the world of Atzilut. (Item 17).
